annotations.title: Choose where referrer request emails go

description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. For one of the user's referrer registrations, chooses whether new referral request emails go to their techjobs.vn account email or to the work email, and optionally whether they arrive one per request or as one daily summary. Calling it again with the same values changes nothing.

daily_digest.description: true = one summary email at 09:00 ICT instead of one per request; false = one per request. Omit to keep.

to_account_email.description: true = email new requests to the techjobs.vn account email; false = to the work email.

name: set_referrer_email_notifications

daily_digest.description: The frequency set by this call; null when it was left unchanged.
